profile.headline: Software Engineer at FreeWheel, A Comcast Company
profile.summary:
Currently working with Golang and React. Past experiences in Python, Java, Ruby on Rails, Angular, Rust.
Industries I've worked in: Advertising, Video, Digital Identity, Blockchain, Healthcare, Non-Profits
I have done Backend, Frontend, Mobile Apps, R&D, Product, QA Testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: FreeWheel, a Comcast company, helps the largest players in the television industry generate revenue from their ad-supported content through a robust technology platform for ad management and monetization, a private marketplace for premium television inventory, and advisory services. FreeWheel's solutions are used by companies like ABC, DIRECTV, ESPN, Hulu, NBCUniversal, and many more to profitably monetize their professional content on desktop, mobile, OTT, and traditional STB devices.
